release_notes:
Enhanced subtitle management with online SubDL search, appearance customization, offline subtitle downloading, and intuitive swipe controls.

Added
- Online subtitle search powered by SubDL with custom title query input and language filters
- Subtitle appearance settings: font size, text colors, background box styles, and elevation positioning
- Automatic subtitle download alongside offline movies and TV series episodes
- Swipe gestures in media player: left-side vertical swipe for brightness and right-side vertical swipe for volume
- Batch 'Download All' and episode selection options on Series Details page and Season headers

Changed
- Modernized delete icons for single episode and bulk season removals in offline downloads
- Improved subtitle synchronization and audio-dialogue alignment tools

Fixed
- SubDL search error handling to prevent 502 Bad Gateway when titles are not matched
- Offline subtitle loading and character encoding display
